articles.title: Finland blocks more foreign real estate deals over security concerns
articles.summary: The Defence Ministry has blocked six real estate deals involving prospective buyers from outside the the EU and EEA, citing national security concerns. These purchasers were individuals or companies owned by foreign citizens. This action highlights the government's proactive measures to safeguard strategic assets and prevent potential security risks associated with foreign ownership of property, particularly near sensitive locations, reinforcing national defence interests.

articles.title: MoD inks contracts to buy Tunguska Air Defence Missile System from Russia for ₹445 cr
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Defence signed contracts worth ₹858 crore with Russia's Rosoboronexport to procure the Tunguska Air Defence Missile System. This acquisition is vital for enhancing the Indian Army's air defence capabilities, providing improved protection against aerial threats. The deal also includes provisions for depo-level maintenance and spares, ensuring operational readiness and long-term support for the system.

articles.title: Flight operations at Srinagar airport to be restricted between April-July
articles.summary: Srinagar International Airport will face restricted flight operations from April to July for vital runway repair and upgrade works, announced by the Airport Authority of India (AAI). This significant infrastructure project impacts air travel to and from Jammu and Kashmir for several months, underscoring ongoing national development and maintenance efforts.

articles.title: Ukraine announces ‘mutually beneficial’ defence deal with Saudi Arabia
articles.summary: Ukraine has signed a defence agreement with Saudi Arabia, announced amidst escalating Iranian attacks on Gulf countries and regional geopolitical tensions involving the US and Israel. This pact, spearheaded by President Zelenskyy, bolsters Ukraine's international partnerships and allows Saudi Arabia to enhance its security posture against evolving threats.

articles.title: What is Tunguska air defence system India just bought from Russia
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence has signed contracts worth Rs 858 crore to strengthen India's defence capabilities. This includes procuring the 2K22 Tunguska air defence missile system, enhancing ground-based air defence. Additionally, funds are allocated for depot-level inspection of the P-8I long-range maritime reconnaissance aircraft, ensuring its operational readiness and vital surveillance capabilities are maintained for national security.

articles.title: Israel launches new wave of strikes on Iran with no sign of diplomatic breakthrough
articles.summary: Israel initiated a new series of strikes against Iran on Friday, escalating regional tensions. This military action occurred even as US President Donald Trump claimed peace talks were progressing well and extended a deadline for Tehran. The situation highlights the complex interplay of military engagements and diplomatic efforts in the Middle East.
